name: flow
description: DAG-based task execution engine. Turns a user request into atomic subtasks, builds a DAG with deterministic per-node validators, executes independent nodes in parallel via git-worktree-isolated agents, and performs merge+validate as an independent cascade step (git-conflict → project tests → LLM semantic review). Persistent state under .claude/workflows/flow/{task-id}/ enables resume. Commands: /flow, /flow-status, /flow-resume, /flow-graph.
